_comment: Machine-readable pins for the verbatim license copies in this directory. scripts/license-gate.ts fails the build if the toolchain does not match, so an upgrade cannot silently leave THIRD-PARTY.md describing a runtime that is no longer in the binary. The three revisions below are one chain and the gate checks every link: `bun --revision` reports bun-revision; bun-revision is the commit tag bun-v1.3.14 points at; that commit's scripts/build/deps/webkit.ts and scripts/build/deps/tinycc.ts name the WebKit and tinycc revisions. Provenance with read dates is in RELINKING.md.
